interpretation_notes: Single-panel UV-Vis difference spectrum with a fully visible boxed plotting region. No visible subpanel tag is printed on the image, so the task record target label was used to identify the only panel. Anchor points were taken from visible tick-mark centers on the bottom and left axes and validated with the axis-fit utility.

x.visible_pattern: Tick labels run from 300 to 800 in uniform 100 nm steps, and the visible tick marks are evenly spaced across the axis.
x.justification: The axis-fit utility selected a linear model with normalized RMSE about 0.0002; the log10 candidate was much worse.

y.visible_pattern: Tick labels run from -0.3 to 0.5 in uniform 0.1 steps, including zero and negative values, and the visible tick marks are evenly spaced vertically.
y.justification: The axis-fit utility selected a linear model with normalized RMSE about 0.0004; log10 is incompatible with the visible zero and negative tick values.
